## Purpose and Entry Points
Claude-Mem is a TypeScript persistent-memory system for coding agents. It captures agent/session activity, turns it into structured observations and summaries, stores and indexes it, then injects or exposes relevant past context in later sessions. Main entry points are the installer/CLI (`src/npx-cli/index.ts`), host-hook command dispatcher (`src/cli/hook-command.ts`), local MCP server (`src/servers/mcp-server.ts`), and local worker bootstrap (`src/services/worker-service.ts`). Plugin-distributed launch wrappers live in `plugin/scripts/`.

## Host Integration and Event Ingestion
Adapters normalize lifecycle events from Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Windsurf, Antigravity, and raw inputs before handler dispatch. Session start, user messages, tool/file activity, summaries, and session end form the capture boundary; privacy and project-scoping logic must apply here before persistence or model calls. Primary paths: `src/cli/adapters/index.ts`, `src/cli/handlers/index.ts`, `src/cli/handlers/observation.ts`. Transcript watching is an alternate ingestion path for hosts without hooks, notably Grok Bot: `src/services/transcripts/watcher.ts`, `src/services/transcripts/processor.ts`.

## Local Runtime and Process Ownership
The default local architecture is a Bun-managed worker service, supervised for health, port ownership, startup/restart, and graceful shutdown. The worker serves HTTP APIs, viewer assets, event streams, and performs asynchronous observation generation; hook clients communicate with this runtime rather than directly owning the database/model pipeline. Key boundaries: `src/services/worker-spawner.ts`, `src/services/infrastructure/ProcessManager.ts`, `src/services/worker/http/shared.ts`, `src/supervisor/index.ts`.

## Memory Processing and Generation
Within the worker, session state and buffered events are transformed into observations, formatted responses, and wrapups. Provider dispatch supports Anthropic/Claude, Gemini, OpenRouter, and OpenAI-compatible endpoints; provider-specific failure handling, rate limits, retries, and privacy validation isolate external LLM behavior from ingestion. Core paths: `src/services/worker/SessionManager.ts`, `src/services/worker/agents/ResponseProcessor.ts`, `src/services/worker/provider-dispatch.ts`, `src/services/worker/validation/PrivacyCheckValidator.ts`.

## Storage, Search, and Context Assembly
SQLite is the primary local system of record for sessions, observations, prompts, and tool uses; its FTS search is the local retrieval baseline. Optional Chroma synchronization adds vector retrieval, and the search orchestrator selects SQLite, Chroma, or hybrid strategies. Retrieved records are compiled under token budgets into injected context or MCP responses. Paths: `src/services/sqlite/SessionStore.ts`, `src/services/worker/search/SearchOrchestrator.ts`, `src/services/sync/ChromaSync.ts`, `src/services/context/ContextBuilder.ts`.

## APIs, MCP, Viewer, and Progressive Disclosure
The worker HTTP routes expose memory, session, search, sync, settings, and viewer endpoints. MCP makes memory available to agents through compact search, timeline expansion, and full-observation retrieval, preserving the progressive-disclosure/token boundary. The React viewer consumes REST and SSE updates for a live memory stream. Paths: `src/services/worker/http/routes/SearchRoutes.ts`, `src/servers/mcp-server.ts`, `src/ui/viewer/App.tsx`, `src/services/worker/SSEBroadcaster.ts`.

## Hosted Server and Cloud Sync
A separate server runtime supports authenticated multi-user/team storage and server-side generation. It uses PostgreSQL for durable server data and Redis-backed queue configuration for generation jobs; routes are protected by auth, rate limiting, and usage metering. Local cloud sync maintains canonical content/outbox application, while `workers/sync-hub` is a Cloudflare Worker/Durable Object WebSocket synchronization hub. Paths: `src/server/runtime/ServerService.ts`, `src/storage/postgres/index.ts`, `src/server/jobs/ServerJobQueue.ts`, `src/services/sync/CloudSync.ts`, `workers/sync-hub/src/do/SyncHub.ts`.

## Distribution and External Dependencies
Node.js 20+ runs installation/CLI tooling; Bun runs the local worker; SQLite is bundled/local; uv/Python supports Chroma vector search. Installers register host integrations and runtime dependencies, while Docker compose supports deployment/E2E paths. External services include LLM providers, optional cmem hosted APIs, Postgres/Redis in server mode, Cloudflare sync infrastructure, and opt-in telemetry. Relevant paths: `src/npx-cli/commands/install.ts`, `src/services/integrations/McpIntegrations.ts`, `docker-compose.yml`, `src/services/telemetry/telemetry.ts`.
